summary: Interleaved session routing during model version swap yields inconsistent responses for pinned sessions
description:
Issue summary: BrightLearn reports inconsistent responses within the same user session after a scheduled weighted rollout (gradual shift) of open-llama-13b-v2. Session was pinned to the older model but intermittently got routed to a canary variant during the version swap.

Impact: Several production users observed mid-conversation changes in response format and hallucinations. Customer has ~1200 monthly active pinned sessions on Dedicated pool in us-east and reports degraded UX and a regression in conversation continuity.

Environment: Dedicated capacity (reserved pool: dlx-dedicated-us-east-3). Rollout started 2026-03-09 22:00 UTC using rollout-controller v2.4.1. Session pinning enabled via PinBySession header.

Steps to reproduce: see steps_to_reproduce field.

Logs & traces: see logs field.

Expected behavior: Pinned sessions should remain pinned to the target model variant and not be subject to canary weights during an in-place weighted shift.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer creates a conversation session with PinBySession: true and receives responses from open-llama-13b-v1.
2) Operator initiates weighted rollout to open-llama-13b-v2 via rollout-controller (weights ramp 0 -> 20% -> 50% over 2 hours).
3) During the 20% stage, several requests for the pinned session receive 200 OK but responses come from open-llama-7b-quantized canary (shorter outputs, different tokenization).
4) Repeating the same request within the session returns mixed results (sometimes v1 outputs, sometimes canary outputs).
logs: 2026-03-09T22:08:12Z gateway: req_id=abc123 session_id=sess-7k4 route=pin->v1 served_by=host-24; latency=42ms
2026-03-09T22:08:18Z gateway: req_id=abc125 session_id=sess-7k4 route=pin->v1 served_by=host-18; latency=40ms
2026-03-09T22:09:02Z rollout-controller: applied-weight open-llama-13b-v2=0.2 on pool dlx-dedicated-us-east-3
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: rollout-controller weight sampling incorrectly ignored session pin flag when sampling fallback/variant routes.
Checked rollout-controller logs: weights applied correctly and sampling routine executed on a separate async path (see PR suspicion below).

Serving-runtime logs show canary variant serving requests for pinned sessions; KV cache headers show 'kv-cache-miss: true' for those requests suggesting mismatch in cache keying when switching variants.

Observed that gateway routing cached route decisions for 5s but session-affinity cache was updated asynchronously; race window could allow a weighted sample to override pin decision for in-flight requests.
Identified related internal ticket INT-4102 (session-affinity-cache-expiry) and INT-4208 (rollout-controller-async-sampler).
comments: Leah Kim (Support) 2026-03-10: Opened with initial triage and CC'd SRE and Product. Customer provided sample conversation transcripts and request IDs.
Marco Alvarez (SRE) 2026-03-10: Reproduced in staging with a synthetic pinned session and a 10% canary; observed interleaved routing. Captured flamegraphs for routing path.

Sara O'Neill (Product) 2026-03-11: Noted rollout-controller v2.4.1 introduced async sampling for scale; suspect sampling path omitted session-pin check. Adding to product backlog and blocking further rollouts until root cause found.
Customer (BrightLearn) 2026-03-11: Reported regression affecting pilot users; requested immediate mitigation / rollback plan.
resolution_notes: Mitigation applied 2026-03-11 03:14 UTC: Disabled async sampling path in rollout-controller (temporary flag) and enforced session-pin precedence at gateway proxy layer.
Rollback recommendation: Customer rolled back to pinned model version for affected pool for 1 hour while fix is validated.

Long-term fix: Patch rollout-controller to include session-pin check in the sampling path and add unit tests for session-affinity under weighted sampling. PR #872 contains the change; target release v2.4.2.
Follow-ups: Add an alert on 'pinned-session-routing-divergence' to detect >0.1% divergence and update runbook with step to disable async sampler.
